sn47.48:1.1: Ye bhikkhave anukampeyyātha || ye ca sotabbam maññeyyuṃ mittā vā amaccā vā ñāti vā sālohitā vā || te vo bhikkhave catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanāya samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā ||
sn47.48:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ||
sn47.48:2.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 4.
sn47.48:2.6: Ye bhikkhave anukampeyyātha ye ca sotabbam maññeyyum mittā va amaccā vā ñati vā sālohitā vā || te vo bhikkhave imesaṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanāya samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā ti || || 1.
